authority_note: §64. Worker self-reported success is NEVER an authoritative performance signal. Every entry must name the trusted outcome it derives from and the confidence of that source. An entry without an evidence source is inadmissible.
first_pass_note: §99. First-pass acceptance is weighted separately because a cheap model needing repeated correction can cost more than an expensive one that succeeds once.

owner_override_handling.note: §74 requires that overrides not silently rewrite learned routing performance, but is silent on whether overridden runs are recorded at all. Recording them while excluding them from scores preserves the audit trail without biasing the ledger.

cold_start.note: The prior is COMPUTED from DIAL's own rating-bearing outcomes, not typed in. Ranking a pair 'below an unknown' is only informative when the unknown is pegged to reality; against a guess it says nothing.
cold_start.owner_decision: Owner approved the hybrid on 2026-09-13: calibrate the prior, and let the smoothing weight act as the confidence dial.
cold_start.seed_note: Used only until there is enough evidence to compute a real one. Inherited from harness-capability-exchange.mjs.
cold_start.only_rating_bearing_note: Resource-caused failures are excluded, so they cannot drag the population mean down either.
cold_start.weight_note: The smoothing weight is LEARNED, not configured. Empirical Bayes reads it from how much the pairs actually differ: alike pairs mean the differences are mostly noise, so shrink hard (high weight); widely differing pairs mean the differences are real, so trust each record sooner (low weight). Method of moments on a Beta prior, with each pair's own binomial sampling noise subtracted first -- otherwise a fleet measured on small samples looks far more varied than it is and the weight collapses.
cold_start.weight_bounds_note: The bounds guard against a pathological estimate from thin data; they are not tuning. Read them as jobs before a pair's own record carries half its score, which is what the weight means. min 6: two bad runs must not halve a pair's standing. max 30: past this the ledger would be decorative at DIAL's job volume. A clamped estimate is flagged so thin data is visible rather than silent.

entries_note: Empty by construction. DIAL has no harness x model execution evidence yet; the legacy worker cards also carry sample_count 0. Populated only from trusted outcomes at execution-receipt time.

attribution.note: Before an outcome may move a pair's rating, DIAL decides WHY it went that way. A pair that did badly because the resources it was given were inadequate has not underperformed -- the resources have. Counting that against the pair would poison the ledger and progressively misroute work away from a model that was never the problem.
attribution.owner_decision: Owner ruled on 2026-09-13 that a pair's rating must be evaluated for whether the resources provided -- information, skills, rules -- caused the outcome. If so the pair is not demoted and VEKL is updated instead.
attribution.precedence_note: A resource deficit outranks a pair-performance signal: a worker that missed an acceptance criterion it was never given has not ignored it. External outranks both.
attribution.no_signal_note: Silence is not evidence against the worker. An unattributed outcome is held out of the rating.
